question: How does the one reality manifest as the path of mantras?
premises: The reality manifests by virtue of its own freedom.
When abiding in the nature of the knowing subject, it is recognized as the path of mantras.
inference: Through its own freedom, the reality appears as autonomous and, in the subject's mode, is recognized as the mantra path.
plain_english: By its own freedom, that same reality shines forth as autonomous; when it abides in the form of the knowing subject, it is recognized as the path of mantras.
